inputs.custom_prompt: Describe this character in detail for a turnaround sheet. Focus on: gender, approximate age, clothing (color, style, material), hair (color, length, style), body type, distinguishing features (scars, tattoos, accessories), footwear, and any props. Write as a single concise paragraph, no bullet points. Example: 'a man in his 40s wearing a dark blue suit with a red tie, short gray hair, athletic build, leather shoes, silver watch on left wrist'
